raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece of land behind my house, less than one hectare, so buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer is too expensive and too much for it. I kept some cassava stems and yam setts from last season's harvest, so I will cut and plant those local ones rather than spend money on improved seed. I will carry compost from my kitchen waste and chicken droppings to put on the mounds since I own this land and want to keep it fertile. My children and I will clear the plot, make the mounds, and do the weeding ourselves, so I do not need to pay any hired labor.
